problem_description: forwprop: Reset the range of a rewritten MOD result [PR101179] (PR tree-optimization/101179): When X may be negative, r17-3791 still rewrites M = X % PHI <2^a, 2^b> into M = X & PHI <2^a-1, 2^b-1> because M is only compared with zero. That keeps the zero-ness of M but not its value, yet the range recorded for M before the rewrite stays, so VRP folded M to 0 in the testcase. Reset the flow-sensitive info of M in that case. Bootstrapped and regression tested on... [Fix details: * tree-ssa-forwprop.cc (simplify_phi_result_movdiv): Reset the flow-sensitive info of the result when its value changes.]

match.pd: Check that a - c does not wrap in minmax (a - c, b) + c [PR127103] (PR tree-optimization/127103): r17-4378 folds minmax (a - c, b) + c to minmax (a, b + c) when b + c cannot overflow.  The fold also needs a - c not to wrap: for unsigned a = 0, b = 0, c = 1, MIN (a - c, b) + c is 1 but MIN (a, b + c) is 0, and the MAX form gives 0 against 1.  Require that with range_op_handler (MINUS_EXPR).overflow_free_p on the ranges of a and c. The std::vector::push_back case from the... [Fix details: * match.pd (minmax (a - c, b) + c): Also require that a - c does not overflow.]

c++/modules: ICE with GMF variable later defined inline [PR126783] (PR c++/126783): Here transfer_defining_module (added in r16-5213) assumes that if a redeclaration has DECL_LANG_SPECIFIC allocated, then so must the original declaration, but this isn't true for q below.  Instead we should call retrofit_lang_decl to allocate DECL_LANG_SPECIFIC as needed; other parts of duplicate_decls do the same. [Fix details: * module.cc (transfer_defining_module): Call retrofit_lang_decl instead of assuming the old declaration already has DECL_LANG_SPECIFIC allocated.]

aarch64: Fix aarch64_evpc_rev64_ext for testing_p case [PR127599] (PR target/127599): r17-3712-g4182cf11e1e3d2 added some code to expand a perm based on if we are in a loop or not.  The problem is in the testing case, the expanding stmt might not have a bb associated with it and that causes an ICE. This fixes the issue by moving the check for testing before the test of inside the loop. Pushed as obvious after bootstrapped and testing on aarch64-linux-gnu. [Fix details: * config/aarch64/aarch64.cc (aarch64_evpc_rev64_ext): Move the testing_p after the is_bb_in_loop test.]
